public_allegation.es: Gil Marer acusa directamente a Francisco Mario Matos Matas, Antonio Cogolludo Rojas, Shaila María Cogolludo Ramos, José Daniel Acosta Matos y Laura Patricia Acosta Matos de haber operado, a más tardar en 2018, como una estructura coordinada de administradores de hecho o en la sombra sobre la esfera patrimonial y empresarial de Luchy Playa Blanca y la plataforma hotelera integrada; atribuye separadamente al administrador concursal comisiones y omisiones de habilitación, y al juez Alberto López Villarrubia actos y omisiones que habrían preservado el mecanismo y saboteado o frustrado una salida desarrollada y respaldada por financiación.
public_allegation.en: Gil Marer directly accuses Francisco Mario Matos Matas, Antonio Cogolludo Rojas, Shaila María Cogolludo Ramos, José Daniel Acosta Matos and Laura Patricia Acosta Matos of operating, by 2018 at the latest, as a coordinated de facto or shadow-administration structure over Luchy Playa Blanca's patrimonial and business sphere and the integrated hotel platform; he separately attributes enabling commissions and omissions to the insolvency administrator, and acts and omissions to Magistrate-Judge Alberto López Villarrubia that allegedly preserved the mechanism and sabotaged or frustrated a developed, finance-backed exit.

insolvency_administrator.name: Francisco de Borja Rodríguez-Batllori Laffitte
insolvency_administrator.direct_allegation: Gil alleges affirmative enablement through emails, meetings, requests, authorisations, decisions, implementation, adoption and ratification, as well as omissions after notice.

judge.name: Alberto López Villarrubia
judge.direct_allegation: Gil alleges decisions, refusals, evidential closures, delay and omissions that preserved the private-control result and sabotaged or frustrated the financeable exit.

direct_allegation.es: Gil Marer alega que Aweswell cumplió o podía cumplir las condiciones de promotor, prestatario o contraparte bajo su control; que las dependencias operativas bloqueadas fueron la preservación y entrega escalonada de garantías y colateral, la autorización judicial y la certificación exacta de deuda por el Administrador Concursal; y que la cadena privada, concursal y judicial las controló, desplazó o socavó mediante un mecanismo coercitivo alegado de control paralelo o acreedor en posesión que obstruyó la redención y refinanciación.
direct_allegation.en: Gil Marer alleges that Aweswell performed or could perform the sponsor-side, borrower-side or counterparty conditions within its control; that the operative blocked dependencies were staged security and collateral preservation and delivery, judicial authority and an accurate Insolvency Administrator debt certificate; and that the private, insolvency and judicial chain controlled, displaced or undermined them through an alleged coercive parallel-control or lender-in-possession mechanism obstructing redemption and refinancing.

sponsor_borrower_or_counterparty.gil_position: Performed or capable of performance within Aweswell's control.
examples: acceptable ECO valuation and agreed LTV
hotel-operation agreement, business plan and owner-side authority
evidence of creditor amounts and required exit amount
progressive formalisation of pre-exit and post-exit security

court_administrator_or_collateral_depend.gil_position: Alleged operative blockage controlled or undermined across the five-actor, Administrator and judicial chain.
examples: Mercantile Court authority for first-ranking mortgages
Administrator or liquidator certificate that VSO-route concursal and estate liabilities did not exceed EUR 13.84 million
judicial or documentary evidence that borrowing sufficed to exit
preservation, availability and delivery of the staged collateral package
court-account payment or deposit sufficient to permit LPB's exit
other lender, credit, management and board approvals or waivers
Lagune board, due-diligence, definitive-SPA and clean-title conditions

route_source_status.ona_clubotel: Signed 6 June lease and addendum name the Owners' Community and Clubotel La Dorada as legal parties; contemporaneous correspondence describes ONA as intended operator. Effect was conditional on sufficient court-account funding and owner approval; ONA was not the funder and is not collapsed into Clubotel.
route_source_status.stoneweg_vso: Stoneweg correspondence described an Oferta Vinculante, while the VSO primary instrument was an Oferta Vinculante Condicionada requiring mortgages/LTV, judicial authority, an Administrator certificate capped at EUR 13.84 million, ECO valuation, Matkator due diligence, VSO management/credit approval and other conditions; closing and drawdown are not proved.
route_source_status.ben_oldman: The current canonical source records a separate later Binding Term Sheet signed by the lender-side signatory, Aweswell and Matkator, with staged pre-exit and post-exit security; it was not a definitive facility, proof of universal condition satisfaction, closing or drawdown.
route_source_status.lagune_elaia: The controlled record distinguishes a buyer-signed, nonbinding EUR 26 million Lagune proposal from a separate Aweswell-signed conditional preferred-right letter to Elaia; seller and Elaia acceptances were blank, and no Lagune-to-Elaia subsidiary bridge or binding takeout is proved.

publication_boundaries: no verified only-condition claim without route-specific primary proof
Gil's sponsor-side performance position is not independent proof that every condition was satisfied
lender, credit, management and board approvals remain separate from borrower-side performance
no unconditional funding, inevitable closing or adjudicated sabotage
use attributed institutional parallel-control or lender-in-possession wording

AC request for security, attendance at Community meetings and identified access or maintenance authorisations
AC use of creditor-generated Community certificates or calculations in the liquidation record
Daniel Irigoyen's contemporaneous report of one 13 June 2018 meeting with the judge and a later same-day meeting with the Administrator concerning the financeable exit
formal 2017 contingency modification of the Community pre-insolvency claim
formal 2018 holder-only substitution of the secured creditor
later Community/debt figures used in liquidation or better-bid conditions without a currently located post-liquidation incident expressly enlarging the recognised definitive credit
documented staged-security architecture separating closing collateral from post-exit LPB mortgage security
distinct ONA/Clubotel, Stoneweg/VSO, Ben Oldman and Lagune/Elaia route records with different signature, condition and closing status
alleged_effect_chain: later operation, finance and public support
not_proved: adjudicated criminal agreement or common unlawful purpose
full de facto or shadow-administrator legal status for every actor or function
habitual obedience by the Insolvency Administrator to private instructions
knowing falsity of a specific debt, minute, certificate or calculation
adjudicated judicial prevarication, funded-exit sabotage or actor-specific criminal causation
a verified count of further Irigoyen judicial visits
unconditional funding, completed drawdown or inevitable closing of the exit
independent proof that every sponsor-side condition was satisfied for every route
completion or waiver of all lender, credit, management or board approvals
adjudicated deliberate obstruction of the collateral, court-authority or debt-certificate dependencies
automatic knowledge or participation of later investors, advisers, operators, supervisors or funding bodies
decisive_evidence: certified complete court docket, judge diary and post-2016 modification index
native Community authority, voting, minute and accounting records
vendor invoice payer recharge duplicate-cost crosswalk
native AC Community CAM communications, mandates and meeting records
security locksmith key code and access logs
final accounts EUR 400000 trail deed notice and property-by-property Registry chain

route_classes.purpose: make the attributed allegation prominent and show the whole causal chain
test authority, appointments, voting, debt and record custody
test request, authorisation, adoption, reliance, verification, delegation, loyalty and accounting
test practical control, instructions, funding, access, works, benefit and pre-title reach
separate recognised credit, contingent claims, mortgage caps, bid thresholds, consideration and final accounting
test notice, evidence, adversarial process, reasoning, unresolved matters and implementation without presuming prevarication
test title, authority, calculations, testimonios, warnings, cancellation and property-by-property Registry effects
test due diligence, conflicts, conditions, waivers, drawdowns, use of funds and correction without transferring guilt
